answer_page.gloss_en: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see get up, early.

examples.en: Next Tuesday we'll have to get up early, because the site visit starts at dawn.
examples.zh: 下周二我们得早起，因为实地考察在黎明时开始。

answer_page.gloss_en: plural of slipper

examples.en: I keep my slippers beside the bed.
examples.zh: 我把室内拖鞋放在床边。

answer_page.gloss_en: plural of blind

examples.en: Please close the blinds before you go to sleep.
examples.zh: 睡觉前请拉上百叶帘。

answer_page.gloss_en: Abnormal dryness of the mouth

examples.en: I woke up with a dry mouth this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上醒来时我觉得口干。

answer_page.gloss_en: To bathe.

examples.en: She told the children to take a bath and wash off the mud and grime.
examples.zh: 她让孩子们洗个澡，把身上的泥土和污垢洗掉。

answer_page.gloss_en: plural of bristle

examples.en: Rinse the toothbrush to clean the bristles.
examples.zh: 冲洗牙刷，把刷毛洗干净。

answer_page.gloss_en: plural of gum

examples.en: Brush gently to avoid hurting your gums.
examples.zh: 轻轻刷牙，避免伤到牙龈。

answer_page.gloss_en: A brush used in hair care for brushing, tidying, and detangling hair

examples.en: I use a hairbrush to untangle my hair.
examples.zh: 我用发刷把头发梳顺。

answer_page.gloss_en: Pertaining to hygiene; clean, sanitary, free of disease.

examples.en: Wash your hands to keep them clean and hygienic.
examples.zh: 洗手以保持双手清洁卫生。

answer_page.gloss_en: scaly white dead skin flakes from the human scalp; Pityriasis capitis

examples.en: Dandruff is on my collar again.
examples.zh: 我的衣领上又有头皮屑了。

answer_page.gloss_en: A shave that is very short or near the skin.

examples.en: He used a new razor blade for a good close shave.
examples.zh: 他换了一片新刀片，刮得很干净。

answer_page.gloss_en: Between warm and cool.

examples.en: Wash it in lukewarm water.
examples.zh: 用温水清洗它。

examples.en: My curry is lukewarm.
examples.zh: 我的咖喱已经不怎么热了。

answer_page.gloss_en: Clothes worn next to the skin, underneath outer clothing.

examples.en: I packed clean underwear for the weekend trip.
examples.zh: 我为周末旅行收拾了干净的内衣裤。

answer_page.gloss_en: plural of glove

examples.en: Put on your gloves before going outside in the cold.
examples.zh: 天冷出门前戴上手套。

answer_page.gloss_en: plural of flat

examples.en: She chose comfortable flats for the long walk.
examples.zh: 她为长时间步行选了一双舒适的平底鞋。

answer_page.gloss_en: High-heeled shoes.

examples.en: She wore a short skirt and heels.
examples.zh: 她穿着短裙和高跟鞋。

answer_page.gloss_en: plural of loafer

examples.en: These brown loafers go well with my trousers.
examples.zh: 这双棕色乐福鞋和我的长裤很搭。

answer_page.meaning_zh: 商务休闲或得体休闲风格
answer_page.meaning_display: n. 商务休闲或得体休闲风格
answer_page.gloss_en: A style that is informal yet smart enough for a particular situation.

Any standard of dress used in many business environments that is casual overall; it thus excludes most formal clothes (such as a business suit and tie) but also excludes certain overly casual clothes (such as short shorts).
Of a garment, having no sleeves.

examples.en: He wore a sleeveless shirt on the hot afternoon.
examples.zh: 炎热的下午，他穿了一件无袖衫。

answer_page.gloss_en: Of lower body clothing: whose waistline does not reach the waist, but hangs along the hips.

examples.en: She tried on a pair of low-rise jeans.
examples.zh: 她试穿了一条低腰牛仔裤。

answer_page.gloss_en: Having stripes, decorated or marked with bands differing in color.

examples.en: Jim is the boy in the striped polo.
examples.zh: 吉姆就是那个穿条纹Polo衫的男孩。

answer_page.gloss_en: Uneven, with many furrows and prominent points, often in reference to the skin or hide of animals.
Letting air seep through.

examples.en: This breathable fabric keeps me comfortable in warm weather.
examples.zh: 这种透气面料让我在温暖的天气里感觉舒适。

answer_page.gloss_en: A substance that kills germs or viruses.

examples.en: The scalpels were soaked in disinfectant before the operation so disease wouldn't be spread.
examples.zh: 手术前，手术刀浸泡在消毒剂中，以防止疾病传播。

answer_page.gloss_en: An object given by a person and retained in memory of something or someone; something kept for sentimental or nostalgic reasons.

examples.en: She kept the ticket as a keepsake from the trip.
examples.zh: 她把那张票留作旅行纪念。

answer_page.gloss_en: At a distance close enough to touch by reaching.

examples.en: Keep the remote within reach of the sofa.
examples.zh: 把遥控器放在沙发旁伸手可及的地方。

answer_page.gloss_en: Outside the distance to which someone can stretch out their hand.

examples.en: The top shelf is out of reach without a stool.
examples.zh: 不用凳子就够不着最上面的架子。

answer_page.gloss_en: Scattered with a disorderly mixture of objects that occupies space; littered.

examples.en: The desk was cluttered with papers and cables.
examples.zh: 桌上堆满了纸张和电线，显得杂乱。

answer_page.gloss_en: Having plenty of space; roomy; capacious.

examples.en: The apartment has a spacious bedroom.
examples.zh: 这套公寓有一间宽敞的卧室。

answer_page.gloss_en: Containing a dense pack or mass of something; teeming.

examples.en: The storage room was crowded with boxes.
examples.zh: 储藏室里堆满了箱子。

answer_page.gloss_en: present participle and gerund of tidy

examples.en: I spent the morning tidying the living room.
examples.zh: 我花了一上午整理客厅。

answer_page.gloss_en: A device that uses suction, and often agitation, in order to remove dirt and other debris from carpets and hard floors.

examples.en: Use the vacuum cleaner to clean the carpet.
examples.zh: 用吸尘器清洁地毯。

answer_page.gloss_en: Alternative form of scrubbing brush.

examples.en: She used a scrub brush to clean the tiles.
examples.zh: 她用硬毛刷刷洗瓷砖。

answer_page.gloss_en: Capable of being done or fulfilled; achievable.

examples.en: We divided the chores into manageable tasks.
examples.zh: 我们把家务分成了能够完成的小任务。

answer_page.gloss_en: Very tiring.

examples.en: This task is exhausting!
examples.zh: 这项任务真让人筋疲力尽！

answer_page.gloss_en: An equitable or reasonable portion, especially in regards to contributions towards a particular duty, or the dividends thereof.

examples.en: As the company had no dedicated janitor, all employees were expected to do their fair share of cleaning up after lunch.
examples.zh: 由于公司没有专职保洁员，所有员工都应在午餐后公平分担清洁工作。

answer_page.gloss_en: The amount of work assigned to a particular worker, normally in a specified time period.

examples.en: We shared the workload so everyone could finish on time.
examples.zh: 我们分担了工作量，这样大家都能按时完成。
